title: attendance and course material
text: DEMO NOTICE: Attendance and course material Minimum attendance. Students must have at least 75% attendance overall and in each subject to be eligible to sit the end-semester examination. Attendance is counted separately for theory classes and for lab sessions. Low attendance. Students between 65% and 75% in a subject may apply for attendance condonation through their department office with a valid reason such as a medical certificate. A condonation fee of Rs 500 per subject applies. Students below 65% are not eligible for condonation and will be detained in that subject. Admit cards are held until the condonation decision is announced. Attendance updates. Attendance is updated on the student portal every Friday. Students who find an error should contact their class coordinator within 7 days with the date and subject. Course material. Lecture notes, assignments and previous question papers are shared by the relevant department through the college learning portal. Assignments must be submitted on the portal by the due date; late submissions lose 10% of the marks per day. This is sample data for the CampSage prototype.

title: campus overview
text: DEMO NOTICE: Campus overview and block names This is sample data for the CampSage prototype. The block names and contents below are fictional. Block-A: main gate side, transport office, seminar hall and library. Block-B: Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) department, computer labs and lecture halls. Block-C: Electronics and Communication (ECE) department, Computer Applications (BCA) department and the embedded systems lab. Block-D: admission office, accounts office and fee counter on the ground floor, scholarship cell on the 1st floor. Block-E: examination office on the 1st floor. The hostel, canteen and medical room are behind Block-E. Offices are open 10:00 to 16:00, Monday to Saturday.

title: certificates and id card notice
text: DEMO NOTICE: Certificates, ID card and no-dues Bonafide and other certificates. A bonafide certificate, character certificate or fee certificate can be requested on the student portal. The fee is Rs 100 per certificate and it is ready in 3 working days. Urgent same-day service costs Rs 300. Mark sheets and transcripts. Duplicate mark sheets cost Rs 500 each; official transcripts cost Rs 1,000 and take 7 working days. ID card. A lost college ID card can be replaced for Rs 200 after submitting an application with a copy of the FIR or a written declaration. ID cards are required for entering the campus and for every exam. No-dues certificate. Final-year students need no-dues clearance from the accounts office, library and hostel before the degree certificate. Clearance is issued only after all fees, fines and dues are cleared. Name or date of birth correction. A correction request needs a copy of the school certificate and takes 15 working days. This is sample data for the CampSage prototype.

title: exam rules and admit card
text: DEMO NOTICE: Exam rules and admit card Admit card. Admit cards are available on the examination portal from 7 days before the first paper. Students must carry a printed admit card and the college ID card to every paper. Students without an admit card are not allowed into the hall. Admit card on hold. An admit card is held if the student has overdue fees, attendance below 75% without an approved condonation, or pending documents. The student must clear the issue at the examination cell, Block A, room 12. Reporting time. Students must reach the exam hall 30 minutes before the start of the paper. Entry is closed 30 minutes after the paper starts. Allowed items. Pen, pencil, transparent geometry box and a basic non-programmable calculator where the question paper permits. Mobile phones, smart watches and notes are not allowed and their use is treated as unfair means. Seating. The seat number appears on the admit card and the seating plan is displayed outside each hall. Results. Results are declared within 30 days of the last paper on the examination portal. This is sample data for the CampSage prototype.

title: fee payment notice
text: DEMO NOTICE: Fee payment deadline Deadline. The sample fee notice says students must clear the semester fee by 30 October 2026. Students whose fee is overdue from an earlier instalment must clear it immediately. Late fee. A late fee of Rs 100 per day is charged after the due date. Students with unpaid fees cannot complete registration, and their admit card may be held. How to pay. Use the student fee portal by UPI, net banking or card. Cash payments are accepted at the accounts office, Block A, from 10:00 to 15:00 on working days. Keep the receipt; the receipt number is needed for any query. Instalments. Postgraduate and professional programmes (such as MBA) may pay in two equal instalments. Undergraduate students may request a one-time instalment plan by applying to the accounts office before the due date. Refunds. Payments made twice by mistake are refunded to the original account in 10 to 15 working days after a written request with both receipts. Fee help. Write to the accounts office with the student ID and receipt number. This is sample data for the CampSage prototype.

title: helpdesk and grievance notice
text: DEMO NOTICE: Helpdesk and grievance redressal Student helpdesk. The student helpdesk is in Block A, ground floor, open from 10:00 to 16:00 on working days. It handles fee, registration, certificate, ID card and portal login queries. Examination cell. Admit card, revaluation and result queries go to the examination cell, Block A, room 12. Grievance. Students can submit grievances about classes, faculty, hostel or facilities on the grievance form on the portal. A reply is given within 7 working days. Complaints can be made anonymously. Anti-ragging and safety. The anti-ragging helpline is available 24 hours. Incidents are handled by the anti-ragging committee with strict confidentiality. Counselling. Free confidential counselling is available at the student wellness centre on Monday, Wednesday and Friday from 11:00 to 15:00. Portal login. If the portal password does not work, use the reset option or visit the helpdesk with the college ID card. This is sample data for the CampSage prototype.

title: holiday and academic calendar
text: DEMO NOTICE: Holiday and academic calendar Holidays. The college is closed on 20 October 2026 for Dussehra, 8 November 2026 for Diwali, and 15 November 2026 for Govardhan Puja. Classes resume the next working day. Examination papers are not scheduled on holidays. Important dates. Elective registration 15-25 October 2026. Fee payment deadline 30 October 2026. End-semester examinations 22 October to 5 November 2026. Practical examinations begin 9 November 2026. Scholarship applications close 10 November 2026. Orientation programme 2 November 2026. Winter break. The winter vacation is from 25 December 2026 to 3 January 2027. The next semester begins on 11 January 2027. Working hours. Academic classes run from 09:00 to 16:00 from Monday to Friday. The administrative offices are open from 10:00 to 16:00. This is sample data for the CampSage prototype.

title: hostel rules notice
text: DEMO NOTICE: Hostel rules and fees Hostel fee. The sample hostel fee is Rs 18,000 per semester, including mess charges. A refundable security deposit of Rs 6,000 is paid once at admission. Timings. Hostel curfew is 22:00 on weekdays and 23:00 on weekends. Late entry needs prior written permission from the warden. Visitors. Visitors are allowed in the visitor lounge from 16:00 to 18:00 only. Leave. For a stay outside the hostel overnight, the student must submit the leave form on the portal and inform the warden at least one day earlier. Room change. Room change requests can be made in the first two weeks of each semester through the warden's office. Mess. The mess serves breakfast 07:30-09:00, lunch 12:30-14:30 and dinner 19:30-21:30. Mess feedback can be given to the mess committee every Saturday. Complaints. Maintenance complaints are raised on the hostel desk and resolved within 3 working days. This is sample data for the CampSage prototype.

title: library rules notice
text: DEMO NOTICE: Library rules Issue limit. Undergraduate students can issue up to 4 books for 14 days. Postgraduate students can issue up to 5 books for 21 days. Each book can be renewed once online if no one else has reserved it. Fine. The late fine is Rs 5 per day per book. A student with an overdue book cannot issue new books. Lost books. A lost or damaged book must be replaced or the student pays its current price plus a Rs 200 processing fee. Timings. The library is open from 08:30 to 20:00 on working days and 10:00 to 16:00 on Saturdays. During exams it stays open until 22:00. Digital library. Journals, e-books and previous question papers are available on the learning portal with the college login. No-dues. A library no-dues certificate is required before the final semester results and degree certificate. This is sample data for the CampSage prototype.

title: placement and training notice
text: DEMO NOTICE: Placement and training Eligibility. Final-year students with at least 75% attendance and at most one active backlog can register for campus drives. Students must upload a resume to the training cell portal and get it reviewed before applying. Upcoming drives. TechNova Solutions holds its on-campus online test on 12 November 2026; the roles are Software Engineer and Support Engineer. DataBridge Analytics resume shortlisting is open until 5 November 2026 for the Data Analyst role. Training. Placement training sessions are held every Thursday at 14:00 in the Seminar Hall, covering aptitude, coding practice and mock interviews. Internships. Pre-final year students can apply for the summer internship programme; applications open on 1 December 2026. Dress code. Formal dress is required for all drives and interviews. Late arrival can lead to disqualification. This is sample data for the CampSage prototype.

title: procedure attendance shortage condonation
text: DEMO NOTICE: Procedure for attendance shortage and condonation This is sample data for the CampSage prototype. If your attendance is below the required minimum, you can apply for condonation (a waiver of the shortage) with a valid reason such as illness. Collect proof, such as a medical certificate from a doctor, or an official letter for a college event. Write an application to your Head of Department that names the subjects and dates missed. Submit it with your ID card to Mr. Vikas Saxena, attendance coordinator, CSE department, Block-B, 2nd floor, room B-214 (demo contact). He forwards it to the HoD for approval. Approved cases go to the examination office, Block-E, before the exam form is filled. Apply well before the exam form date. Decisions usually take 3 to 5 working days. Condonation is not guaranteed.

title: procedure bonafide certificate
text: DEMO NOTICE: Procedure to get a bonafide certificate This is sample data for the CampSage prototype. A bonafide certificate proves you are a current student. It is used for bank, scholarship, passport and travel concession forms. Go to the admission office, Block-D, ground floor, room D-101, and meet Mr. Harish Pandey, Admission Officer (demo contact). Carry your ID card and a photocopy of it. Write a short application that says what the certificate is for and who will receive it. Your fee dues should be clear. The certificate is normally issued in 1 to 2 working days, and it needs the signature of the Admission Officer. Ask for extra copies at the same time if you need more than one. Office hours are 10:00 to 16:00, Monday to Saturday.

title: procedure correct name or details
text: DEMO NOTICE: Procedure to correct your name or personal details This is sample data for the CampSage prototype. If your name, date of birth, father's name or other details are wrong in the college record, go to the admission office, Block-D, ground floor, room D-101. Meet Mr. Harish Pandey, Admission Officer (demo contact). Carry your ID card, your class 10 certificate, one government photo ID and photocopies of both. Submit an application that states the wrong detail and the correct detail. Name changes also need an affidavit. If your exam records are affected, the examination office, Block-E, room E-114, must be told too. The correction usually takes 5 to 7 working days. Do it before the exam form date so the marksheet is correct. Office hours are 10:00 to 16:00, Monday to Saturday.

title: procedure elective registration problem
text: DEMO NOTICE: Procedure for an elective registration problem This is sample data for the CampSage prototype. If you cannot register for an elective, first check that your semester fee has no pending amount, because unpaid fees can block registration. Then check that the registration window is still open. If the portal still shows an error, meet Dr. Shalini Awasthi, electives coordinator, CSE department, Block-B, 2nd floor, room B-210 (demo contact). Carry your ID card and a screenshot of the error. Write a short application stating your name, class, the elective you want and the error you see. If the window has closed, ask for late registration in the same application and have the HoD sign it. Dr. Awasthi forwards approved requests to the examination office. The expected resolution time is 1 to 2 working days. Offices are open 10:00 to 16:00, Monday to Friday.

title: procedure exam form admit card issue
text: DEMO NOTICE: Procedure for an exam form or admit card problem This is sample data for the CampSage prototype. If you cannot fill the exam form or download your admit card, check three things first: your fees have no pending amount, your attendance meets the minimum, and your registration is complete. If all three are fine and the portal still blocks you, go to the examination office, Block-E, 1st floor, room E-114. Meet Dr. Anil Mathur, Deputy Controller of Examinations (demo contact). Carry your ID card, the fee receipt and a photocopy of your last marksheet. Submit a short application with your name, class, student ID and the exact problem. A corrected admit card is usually issued in 1 to 2 working days. Do this before the exam date. Office hours are 10:00 to 16:00, Monday to Saturday.

title: procedure fee paid but pending
text: DEMO NOTICE: Procedure when you paid your fees but the portal still shows a pending amount This is sample data for the CampSage prototype. If you paid all your fees but the portal still shows a pending amount, follow these steps. First check your payment receipt. The portal can take up to 48 hours to update after a payment, so wait that long. Keep your receipt number safe. If the amount is still pending after 48 hours, go to the Block-D admission and accounts office, ground floor. Meet Mr. Rakesh Tiwari, Accounts Officer, room D-105 (demo contact). Carry the payment receipt, your ID card and one photocopy of the receipt. Submit a short written application. Sample application: "To the Accounts Officer. I paid my semester fee on (date), receipt number (number), amount (amount). The portal still shows a pending amount. Please verify and update my record. Name, class, student ID." The expected resolution time is 2 to 3 working days. Office hours are 10:00 to 16:00, Monday to Saturday.

title: procedure hostel transport fee query
text: DEMO NOTICE: Procedure for a hostel or transport fee query This is sample data for the CampSage prototype. Hostel and transport fees are separate from the semester fee. For a hostel fee query, meet Mr. Arif Mirza, hostel warden, at the hostel office, room H-01 (demo contact). For a bus or transport fee query, meet Mr. Dinesh Yadav, transport in-charge, Block-A, ground floor, room A-012 (demo contact). Carry your ID card, the payment receipt and the hostel or bus pass number. If you paid but the amount still shows as due, follow the same steps as the semester fee: wait 48 hours, then submit a short application with the receipt number. Resolution usually takes 2 to 3 working days. Office hours are 10:00 to 16:00, Monday to Saturday.

title: procedure lost id card
text: DEMO NOTICE: Procedure when you lose your ID card This is sample data for the CampSage prototype. If you lose your student ID card, first inform your class coordinator. Then go to the admission office, Block-D, ground floor, room D-101, and meet Mr. Harish Pandey, Admission Officer (demo contact). Write a short application saying the card was lost. Carry one passport photo, a photocopy of your fee receipt and a government photo ID. Pay the duplicate ID card fee at the accounts office, Block-D, room D-105, and bring the receipt back. If someone could misuse the card, also tell the college security office at the main gate. A duplicate ID card is usually ready in 3 to 5 working days. Office hours are 10:00 to 16:00, Monday to Saturday.

title: procedure scholarship query
text: DEMO NOTICE: Procedure for a scholarship query This is sample data for the CampSage prototype. For questions about a scholarship, such as a missing amount, a rejected form or a pending verification, go to the scholarship cell, Block-D, 1st floor, room D-204. Meet Mrs. Neelam Chauhan, Scholarship Coordinator (demo contact). Carry your ID card, the scholarship application number, your fee receipt, your income certificate and a bank passbook photocopy. If the form was rejected, bring the rejection message. Write a short application with your name, class, scholarship name and the problem. Ask for the status in writing. Verification usually takes 5 to 7 working days. Office hours are 10:00 to 16:00, Monday to Friday. The real scholarship portal may take longer to update.

title: registration and programmes notice
text: DEMO NOTICE: Registration and college programmes Elective and project registration. The sample registration notice says elective registration is open from 15 October through 25 October 2026. Students with unpaid fees may be blocked from completing registration. Register on the student portal and confirm with the department coordinator. 5th semester B.Tech Computer Science electives: Cloud Computing, Information Retrieval, Mobile App Development. Seats are allotted on a first-come basis, so register early. 7th semester project registration: students must register their project title and guide on the portal and upload the synopsis. Students with an overdue fee cannot register until it is cleared. Orientation. The college programme orientation is listed for 2 November 2026 at the main auditorium at 10:00. Workshops and programmes. A Python and AI workshop runs on 14 and 15 November 2026 and a Resume and Interview skills programme on 18 November 2026. Registration for both is free on the student portal. This is sample data for the CampSage prototype.

title: revaluation and backlog notice
text: DEMO NOTICE: Revaluation and backlog examination Revaluation. Students may apply for revaluation within 10 days of the result declaration on the examination portal. The fee is Rs 800 per subject. The revaluation result is declared in about 3 weeks, and the better of the two marks is kept. Photocopy of answer sheet. Students may request a photocopy of an answer sheet before applying for revaluation. The fee is Rs 400 per subject. Backlog papers. A student who failed a subject may appear in the backlog examination. The backlog exam fee is Rs 1,200 per paper and must be paid before the form deadline of 5 October 2026. Backlog papers: Operating Systems on 4 November 2026 and Digital Signal Processing on 5 November 2026. Backlogs and placement. Most companies allow at most one active backlog. Students are advised to clear backlogs in the next attempt. This is sample data for the CampSage prototype.

title: scholarship notice
text: DEMO NOTICE: Scholarship applications Merit scholarship. Students with a CGPA of 8.0 or above in the previous academic year and no active backlog can apply for the merit scholarship. A CGPA of 9.0 or above receives a 50% tuition waiver. Renewal needs a CGPA of at least 8.5 and 85% attendance. Need-based scholarship. Students whose family annual income is below Rs 4,00,000 can apply with an income certificate. The scholarship covers up to 30% of the tuition fee. Deadline. Applications close on 10 November 2026 on the student portal. Upload the mark sheet, income certificate where needed, and a bank passbook copy. Results. The scholarship list is published on 25 November 2026 and the waiver is adjusted in the next fee instalment. Students with an active backlog or with attendance below 75% are not eligible for the merit scholarship. This is sample data for the CampSage prototype.
